from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path('/tmp/hg-tbi2-audit')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

def ident(p):
    p = Path(p)
    h = hashlib.sha256(); n = 0
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1024*1024), b''):
            n += len(b); h.update(b)
    return {'path':str(p), 'bytes':n, 'sha256':h.hexdigest()}

def raw_ident(path, raw):
    return {'path':path, 'bytes':len(raw), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}

def inline(path, text): return raw_ident(path,text.encode('utf-8'))

def excerpts(rel, spans):
    p=Path(rel) if str(rel).startswith('/') else ROOT / rel
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    return {'source':ident(p),'excerpts':[{'line':n,'text':lines[n-1]} for a,b in spans for n in range(a,min(b,len(lines))+1)]}
